transcript: Speaker A: What are you doing? Speaker B: I am doing make-up in my face. Speaker A: Yaha makeup ke liye "in" nahi, "on" sahi hoga. Kyuki makeup face ke upar apply karte hain, andar nahi. [Here, for makeup, "in" is incorrect, "on" is correct. Because makeup is applied on top of the face, not inside.] Speaker B: Oh... I am doing my make-up on my face. I'm going partying, but I'm too much late. Speaker A: "Much" quantity ke liye use karte hain, late hone ke liye nahi. Try this - "I'm very late". ["Much" is used for quantity, not for being late. Try this - "I'm very late".] Speaker B: Got it. "I'm very late". Yaar, party mein toh pahuch hi jaungi, par apni English ka kya karu? Maine jitna socha tha, ye toh usse bhi zyaada kharab hai. [Got it. "I'm very late". Friend, I'll reach the party anyway, but what do I do about my English? It's even worse than I thought.] Speaker A: Relax.. Tension mat lo. Hum roz aise hi practice karte rahenge. Roz bas 10-15 minute bhi karo, toh kuchh hi dino mein tumhari English bilkul first class ho jayegi. [Relax.. Don't worry. We will keep practicing like this every day. Just do it for 10-15 minutes daily, and in a few days, your English will become absolutely first class.] Speaker A: Aap bhi PW Talk app download karo aur apni English practice start karo. [You too download the PW Talk app and start your English practice.]
